# Update AGENTS.md for the finished theme

After implementation, revise the existing root `AGENTS.md` so coding agents receive durable instructions for this theme rather than assumptions specific to the starter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The guide reflects the actual theme structure, component responsibilities, asset choices and preview process.
- [ ] It preserves the seven-view, layout parameter, URL, encoding, navigation and locale contracts that still apply.
- [ ] Build and preview commands, CI behaviour and validation guidance match what actually works in this repository.
- [ ] It remains concise and does not copy the PRD, TRD, TDD or engine documentation.
